en: Here is the process of getting student ID:

You need to go to the University Press building bring your validated COR and a digital 1x1 picture. Note: this is for freshmen or new students of BukSU, there is no payment for the first ID you will get.
For those who have lost their ID:
Step 1: Go to OVPCAS Present affidavit of loss for lost ID
Step 2: Sign the Logbook
Step 3: Proceed to the Cashiers Office for payment
Step 4: Proceed to University Press for ID printing
cost will be 200 Pesos, process time will be 30 minutes. I will provide a complete Map navigation for you.

Para sa mga nakawala sa ilang ID:
Step 1: Adto sa OVPCAS ipresent ang affidavit of loss para sa nawala nga ID
Step 2: Mopirma sa Logbook
Step 3: Moadto sa Cashier's Office para sa bayad
Step 4: Moadto sa University Press para sa pag-print sa ID
Ang gasto kay 200 Pesos, ang oras sa proseso kay 30 minutos. Hatagan tika og kompleto nga mapa sa navigation para nimo.

en: Yes, students without a physical ID are usually allowed during the first month of the school year, especially first-year students who do not have their ID yet.
You can present your validated COR to the entrance guard so they can verify that you are an officially enrolled first-year student.
Make sure it is a validated COR, and explain clearly why you do not have your student ID yet.
If you lost your student ID, ask the guard about the entry process and explain why your ID is missing. Make sure to bring your validated COR.
If you only forgot your student ID, it is better to go back and bring it. If that is not possible, ask the guard if there is another way to enter temporarily.
Always bring your student ID when entering campus. If you do not have one yet, process your student ID at the University Press.
ceb: Oo, kasagaran allowed ang students nga wala pay physical ID sulod sa unang bulan sa school year, labi na ang first-year students nga wala pa nakakuha sa ilang ID.
Pwede nimo ipakita ang imong validated COR sa entrance guard aron ma-verify nila nga officially enrolled first-year student ka.
Siguroa nga validated COR kini, ug taronga og explain nganong wala pa kay student ID.
Kung nawala imong student ID, pangutana sa guard bahin sa entry process ug isulti nganong nawala imong ID. Siguroa nga dala nimo ang imong validated COR.
Kung nabilin ra nimo imong student ID, mas maayo nga balikan nimo ug dad-on. Kung dili na mahimo, pangutana sa guard kung naa bay temporary way nga makasulod.
Kanunay dad-a imong student ID kung mosulod sa campus. Kung wala pa kay ID, iprocess imong student ID sa University Press.

en: The Information & Communications Technology Services Unit (ICT-SU) of Bukidnon State University. It handles the technical aspect of university processes involving information systems, network, technical services, and web development. ICT-SU is also responsible for maintaining all computers in the computer laboratories, and ensures that any issues or damages in the labs are addressed promptly. You may also approach them for technical assistance regarding computer facilities.
ceb: Ang Information & Communications Technology Services Unit (ICT-SU) sa Bukidnon State University. Mao sila ang ga-atiman sa teknikal nga bahin sa mga proseso sa unibersidad lakip ang information systems, network, technical services, ug web development. Sila usab ang ga-mentinar sa mga computer sulod sa computer laboratory, ug kung naay mga posibleng damage sa mga computers, sila usab ang ga-ayo niini. Pwede ka mo-doul sa ila alang sa tabang sa technical nga aspeto sa computer facilities.

en: Your official BukSU student email address is your institutional email account. It is different from your BukSU Admission account.
For your official BukSU institutional email or student email login, go to the ICT office on the 3rd floor of the Finance Building and ask for assistance with your institutional email account.
Bring your validated COR or student ID if available, because ICT may need to verify that you are an officially enrolled student.
Students may also ask ICT for help if they forgot their institutional email, cannot log in, or need account recovery.
ceb: Ang imong opisyal nga BukSU student email address mao ang imong institutional email account. Lahi kini sa imong BukSU Admission account.
Para sa imong opisyal nga BukSU institutional email o student email login, adto sa ICT office sa 3rd floor sa Finance Building ug pangayo og tabang bahin sa imong institutional email account.
Dad-a ang imong validated COR o student ID kung naa, kay mahimong kinahanglanon sa ICT para ma-verify nga opisyal kang naka-enroll.
Pwede usab mangayo og tabang sa ICT kung nakalimot ka sa institutional email, dili maka-login, o kinahanglan og account recovery.

en: Turn on your Wi-Fi.
Find and select **Student_wifi** (please do not connect to 'Student_Wifi2.0' and other versions since there is only one official student Wi-Fi).
Wait until you are fully connected, and there will be a sign-in option on the Student_wifi. Press that and enter your credentials (Student ID and password).

You are successfully connected. Please note that under other circumstances, the student Wi-Fi in that specific area might be full (connections are full), or the student Wi-Fi is far from the area where you standby, which is why it won't connect easily.
ceb: I-on ang imong Wi-Fi.
Pangitaa ug pilia ang **Student_wifi** (palihog ayaw pagsulay og connect sa 'Student_Wifi2.0' ug uban pang bersyon tungod kay usa ra ang opisyal nga student Wi-Fi).
Paghulat hangtod nga makasumpay ka, ug mogawas ang sign-in option sa Student_wifi. Pindota kana ug isulod ang imong mga credentials (Student ID ug password).

Malampuson ka nang nakasumpay. Palihog timan-i nga sa ubang mga higayon, ang student Wi-Fi sa maong lugar mahimong puno ang connections, o layo ang student Wi-Fi sa lugar kung asa ka nag-standby, hinungdan nga dili dayon kini makakonekta.

en: The Orientation Program is designed to introduce new students to the university’s mission, vision, and academic policies. Its primary goal is to help you adjust to campus life and understand the essential academic expectations of Bukidnon State University.

During this session, you will learn about critical university policies, such as Incomplete (INC) rules and Failure Due to Absences (FDA) counts. Please note that attending your Departmental Orientation is highly required, as it provides specific guidance for your chosen program.
ceb: Ang Orientation Program gihimo aron ipaila sa mga bag-ong estudyante ang mission, vision, ug academic policies sa unibersidad. Ang pangunang tumong niini mao ang pagtabang kanimo nga maka-adjust sa campus life ug masabtan ang mga importanteng academic expectations sa Bukidnon State University.

Sa maong session, makakat-on ka bahin sa mga importanteng patakaran sa unibersidad, sama sa Incomplete (INC) rules ug Failure Due to Absences (FDA) counts. Palihog hinumdumi nga importante kaayo ang pag-attend sa inyong Departmental Orientation, kay didto ihatag ang mga espesipikong giya para sa imong napiling programa.
